youtube.title: Why Golf Balls Have Dimples ⛳ #Shorts
youtube.description:
A perfectly smooth golf ball would only fly about half as far.

Smooth golf balls would fly about half as far. Dimples keep the air clinging to the ball, shrinking the wake behind it, so there's far less drag, and with backspin they help lift the ball too.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
